title: Mitsui Shopping Park app breach, Nov 2026

subject.name: Mitsui Shopping Park
subject.about: The Mitsui Shopping Park app is the shopping app for LaLaport, Mitsui Outlet Park and other Mitsui shopping centres in Japan. Shoppers use it to collect and spend points, pay by phone, get coupons and use parking services.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Mitsui Fudosan, Mitsui Fudosan Commercial Management, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Data on about 3.1 million members of a points scheme used at shopping centres across Japan leaked, and the app they use was out of service from Nov 18 to Nov 27.
who_is_affected: About 3.1 million Mitsui Shopping Park Point members; card details and passwords were not included. The companies are contacting them and warn of fake emails claiming to be from the group. The app is back; members who pay through it may need to register their card again.

known.text: The companies that run the app say a third party got into it without authorisation.
Data on about 3,119,000 members leaked; card details and passwords were not included.
The app was suspended on Nov 18 and the companies say it restarted on Nov 27.

not_known.text: How the intruder got in and who it was; the companies say they know the route but have not said.
